ditto-skill-transform.name: Transform
ditto-skill-transform.description: New skill: copies a foe's form; Focused and Fortified for 2 turns.

ditto-copycat.name: Copycat
ditto-copycat.description: +20% damage to foes carrying a status an ally applied.

ditto-skill-mimic.name: Mimic
ditto-skill-mimic.description: New skill: copies a foe's attack against it, up to 2 hexes away (Power 55).

ditto-skill-recycle.name: Recycle
ditto-skill-recycle.description: New skill: reshapes its body, healing itself 30 HP.

ditto-learning-curve.name: Learning Curve
ditto-learning-curve.description: +10% damage for each hit in a row on the same foe (up to +30%).

ditto-shapeshift.name: Shapeshift
ditto-shapeshift.description: Sheds statuses foes put on it at the start of its turn.

ditto-skill-copied-blow.name: Copied Blow
ditto-skill-copied-blow.description: New skill: mimics a foe's strongest blow on an adjacent foe (Power 90), pushes 1 hex.

ditto-skill-mirror-coat.name: Mirror Coat
ditto-skill-mirror-coat.description: New skill: a mirror sheen blocks all damage to it until its turn ends.

ditto-mirror-skin.name: Mirror Skin
ditto-mirror-skin.description: Foes that hit it from an adjacent hex take 8 damage.

ditto-assimilate.name: Assimilate
ditto-assimilate.description: Knocking out a foe gives +1 Attack (this battle, max +3).

ditto-skill-perfect-copy.name: Perfect Copy
ditto-skill-perfect-copy.description: New skill: turns a foe's own power on it, up to 3 hexes away (Power 95).

ditto-skill-shapeshift-rush.name: Shapeshift Rush
ditto-skill-shapeshift-rush.description: New skill: a fluid lunge up to 2 hexes (Power 70) that ends its engagement.

ditto-fluid-form.name: Fluid Form
ditto-fluid-form.description: +2 movement when it knocks out a foe on its turn.

ditto-rubber-body.name: Rubber Body
ditto-rubber-body.description: Survives one knockout blow per battle at 1 HP.

ditto-imposter-supreme.name: Perfect Imposter
ditto-imposter-supreme.description: Capstone. +2 to every stat; a KO on its turn refreshes its basic attack.

ditto-malleable-mass.name: Malleable Mass
ditto-malleable-mass.description: Capstone. Takes 15% less damage; heals 4% of its max HP each turn.
